propositions.name: aether_provides_absolute_rest
propositions.statement: The aether provides a definite state of rest against which axes and material systems can be said to be at rest or moving with uniform translatory velocity.
propositions.quote: will represent the course of change of the aethereal vectors ( f, g, h ) and ( a, b, c ) of a correlated system of moving electrons referred to axes of (x', y', z') moving through the aether with uniform translatory velocity ( v , 0, 0)

propositions.name: absolute_time_of_rest_system
propositions.statement: There is a well-defined time t belonging to the medium at rest against which the position of an electron in the moving medium at that same time t can be compared to its position in the rest medium at time t minus vx over c squared.
propositions.quote: In the theorem the position of each electron in the material medium in motion, at time t , corresponds with that which it would occupy in the medium at rest at time

propositions.name: definite_velocity_through_aether
propositions.statement: A material body has a definite velocity v of translation through the aether, in a specific direction.
propositions.quote: when this pair is moving through the aether with velocity v in a direction lying in the plane of their orbits, these orbits relative to the translatory motion will be flattened along the direction of v to ellipticity

propositions.name: physical_contraction_from_motion
propositions.statement: Imparting a uniform velocity of translation to a steady material system produces a uniform contraction of the system in the direction of the motion.
propositions.quote: then an effect of imparting to a steady material system a uniform velocity of translation is to produce a uniform contraction of the system in the direction of the motion, of amount

propositions.name: molecular_forces_electric_only
propositions.statement: All internal forces of a material system arise wholly from electrodynamic actions between the systems of electrons which constitute the atoms.
propositions.quote: if the internal forces of a material system arise wholly from electrodynamic actions between the systems of electrons which constitute the atoms

propositions.name: no_forces_other_than_electric
propositions.statement: There are no forces between the electrons other than those that exist through the mediation of the aether, that is, other than electric forces.
propositions.quote: it also implies that there are no forces between the electrons other than those that exist through the mediation of the aether as here defined, that is other than electric forces

propositions.name: electron_strength_invariant
propositions.statement: Motion of a material system containing electrons cannot alter the strengths of its electrons.
propositions.quote: We require however to construct a correlative system devoid of the translatory motion in which the strengths of the electrons shall be equal instead of proportional, since motion of a material system containing electrons cannot alter their strengths

propositions.name: electron_nucleus_singular_point
propositions.statement: The nucleus of the electron is merely a singular point in the aether, with nothing in it of the nature of inertia foreign to the aether.
propositions.quote: the nucleus of the electron is merely a singular point in the aether, that there is nothing involved in it of the nature of inertia foreign to the aether

propositions.name: radiation_common_speed_in_aether
propositions.statement: All kinds of radiations travel with the same speed in the celestial spaces of the free aether.
propositions.quote: The equations of the free aether, as revealed by MacCullagh's optical analysis, are linear equations: they in fact must be so if all kinds of radiations are to travel with the same speed in the celestial spaces

propositions.name: aether_equations_linear
propositions.statement: The equations of the free aether are linear equations.
propositions.quote: The equations of the free aether, as revealed by MacCullagh's optical analysis, are linear equations

propositions.name: gravity_speed_exceeds_radiation
propositions.statement: The speed of transmission of gravitation, if finite at all, enormously transcends that of radiation.
propositions.quote: The knowledge that the speed of transmission of gravitation, if finite at all, enormously transcends that of radiation

propositions.name: doppler_from_time_variable_change
propositions.statement: The change of the time variable in the comparison of radiations in the fixed and moving systems produces the Doppler effect on the wave-length.
propositions.quote: The change of the time variable, in the comparison of radiations in the fixed and moving systems, involves the Doppler effect on the wave-length.

propositions.name: wave_vectors_lie_in_wavefront
propositions.statement: The electric and magnetic vectors of radiation both lie in the wave-front, so wave-fronts and rays correspond between fixed and moving correlated systems.
propositions.quote: As both the electric and magnetic vectors of radiation lie in the wave-front, it follows that in the two correlated systems, fixed and moving, the relative wave-fronts of radiation correspond

propositions.name: michelson_null_result_covered
propositions.statement: The second-order correction of the Fresnel expression on this hypothesis includes Michelson's negative result.
propositions.quote: The second term in this expression is the Fresnel effect, and the remaining term is its second order correction on our hypothesis which includes Michelson's negative result.

propositions.name: null_method_gives_earth_motion_absence
propositions.statement: Because optical measurements are usually made by the null method of adjusting the apparatus so the disturbance vanishes, the general absence of effect of the Earth's motion in optical experiments up to the second order follows.
propositions.quote: As optical measurements are usually made by the null method of adjusting the apparatus so that the disturbance vanishes, this result carries the general absence of effect of the Earth's motion in optical experiments, up to the second order of small quantities.

propositions.name: spectroscopic_celestial_velocity_valid
propositions.statement: The changes of free periods of molecules from convection through the aether are of the second order in v over c, which is vital for spectroscopic measurement of celestial velocities in the line of sight.
propositions.quote: The circumstance that the changes of their free periods, arising from convection of the molecules through the aether, are of the second order in v/c , is of course vital for the theory of the spectroscopic measurement of celestial velocities in the line of sight.

propositions.name: kinetic_energy_decomposes
propositions.statement: The kinetic energy of a moving molecule is made up of an internal energy (the same as at rest, to first order in v over c) together with the energy of translation of its electrons.
propositions.quote: the kinetic energy of the moving molecule is made up of an internal energy, the same up to the first order of the ratio of its velocity to that of radiation as if it were at rest

propositions.name: inertia_defined_as_energy_coefficient
propositions.statement: Inertia is by definition the coefficient of half the square of the velocity in the expression for the translatory energy of the molecule.
propositions.quote: the inertia is by definition the coefficient of half the square of the velocity in the expression for the translatory energy of the molecule

propositions.name: inertia_of_aethereal_origin
propositions.statement: Inertia is mainly of electric, or rather of aethereal, origin.
propositions.quote: it seems fair to conclude that of its energy the electric part prevails equally over the gravitative part: but this is simply asserting that inertia is mainly of electric, or rather of aethereal, origin

propositions.name: kinetic_energy_from_aethereal_square
propositions.statement: The total kinetic energy of the system equals the mean value of the volume-integral of the square of the aethereal disturbance.
propositions.quote: in estimating the mean value of the volume-integral of the square of the aethereal disturbance, which is the total kinetic energy

propositions.name: aethereal_fields_fore_aft_symmetric
propositions.statement: The aethereal fields of the moving electric charges in the molecule are symmetrical fore and aft and unaltered to the first order by the motion.
propositions.quote: the aethereal fields of the moving electric charges, free or constrained, existing in the molecule, will be symmetrical fore and aft and unaltered to the first order by the motion

propositions.name: strength_as_surface_integral
propositions.statement: The strength of an electron is the value of a surface integral of the electric vectors extended over any surface closely surrounding its nucleus.
propositions.quote: But the strength of the electron in the moving system is the value of the integral

propositions.name: adjacent_electron_dominates_near_surface
propositions.statement: If the surface be taken to surround an electron very closely, the wholly preponderating part of each vector is that which belongs to the adjacent electron.
propositions.quote: if the surface be taken to surround the electron under consideration very closely, because then the wholly preponderating part of each vector is that which belongs to the adjacent electron

propositions.name: conductor_structure_unaffected_by_current
propositions.statement: The mechanical structure of a conductor is not sensibly affected when it carries a current.
propositions.quote: we know in fact that the mechanical structure of a conductor is not sensibly affected when it carries a current

propositions.name: ion_migration_velocity_minute
propositions.statement: When a considerable proportion of electrons take part in carrying a current, their velocity of migration is excessively minute.
propositions.quote: their velocity of migration is excessively minute, as for instance follows from the phenomena of migration in electrolysis

propositions.name: intermolecular_forces_via_aether
propositions.statement: The intermolecular forces act through the mediation of the aether in a manner similar to electric and magnetic forces.
propositions.quote: if we assume that the intermolecular forces act through the mediation of the aether in a manner similar to that which we know to be the case in regard to electric and magnetic forces

propositions.name: translation_alters_molecular_action
propositions.statement: The translation of matter will alter the action between two molecules or atoms in a manner similar to that in which it alters the attraction or repulsion between electrically charged particles.
propositions.quote: the translation of the matter will most likely alter the action between two molecules or atoms in a manner similar to that in which it alters the attraction or repulsion between electrically charged particles

propositions.name: no_dispersion_in_free_aether
propositions.statement: Celestial bodies on emerging from eclipse or occupation show no changes of colour, indicating there is no appreciable optical dispersion in free aether.
propositions.quote: the circumstance that celestial bodies on emerging from eclipse or occupation show no changes of colour

propositions.name: electric_prevails_over_gravitative
propositions.statement: In the constitution of the molecule, electric forces or agencies prevail enormously over gravitative ones.
propositions.quote: it is admitted, from electrolytic considerations, that electric forces or agencies prevail enormously over gravitative ones

propositions.name: chemical_constancy_of_mass_electric
propositions.statement: The fundamental chemical law of the constancy of mass throughout molecular transformations is verified for the part of the mass that is of electric origin.
propositions.quote: the fundamental chemical law of the constancy of mass throughout molecular transformations is verified for that part of the mass (whether it be all of it or not) that is of electric origin

propositions.name: maxwell_form_invariance_required
propositions.statement: The scheme of equations referred to moving axes, connecting the new subscripted variables, is identical in form with the Maxwellian scheme of relations for the aethereal vectors referred to fixed axes.
propositions.quote: the scheme of equations, referred to moving axes, which connects together the new variables with subscripts, is identical in form with the Maxwellian scheme of relations for the aethereal vectors referred to fixed axes

propositions.name: transformation_elongates_space
propositions.statement: The transformation from primed to subscripted coordinates signifies an elongation of the space of the problem in a definite ratio along the direction of the motion of the axes of coordinates.
propositions.quote: signifies an elongation of the space of the problem in the ratio

propositions.name: time_scale_rescaling_permitted
propositions.statement: In the correlation of radiations between the fixed and moving systems, the scale of time is enlarged in the ratio epsilon to the one-half, as a coordinate rescaling.
propositions.quote: before the instant considered when the scale of time is enlarged in the ratio

propositions.name: vortex_circulation_unalterable
propositions.statement: The circulation of the vortex is in the dynamical theory an unalterable constant, so one vortex system cannot be changed by natural processes into a rescaled version of the other.
propositions.quote: The circulation of the vortex is however in the dynamical theory an unalterable constant, so that the one system cannot be changed by natural processes into the other

propositions.name: point_nuclei_leave_scale_undetermined
propositions.statement: If the atoms of matter were constituted electrically with point nuclei and forces wholly of electric origin, there would be nothing to determine the scale of an isolated system as regards time and space.
propositions.quote: if the atoms of matter were constituted electrically, and the forces between them were wholly of electric origin, there would be nothing to determine the scale of an isolated system as regards time and space
